mapper.insert: INSERT INTO history ( user_id, project_id, environment_id, site_id, method, url, response_code, response_time, logged_time, header, parameter, form_parameter, response_body, response_header) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{projectId}, #{environmentId}, #{siteId}, #{method}, #{url}, #{responseCode}, #{responseTime}, #{loggedTime}, #{header}, #{parameter}, #{formParameter}, #{responseBody}, #{responseHeader} );
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, project_id AS projectId, environment_id AS environmentId, site_id AS siteId, method AS method, url AS url, response_code AS responseCode, response_time AS responseTime, logged_time AS loggedTime, header AS header, parameter AS parameter, form_parameter AS formParameter, response_body AS responseBody, response_header AS responseHeader FROM history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY logged_time DESC

SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, project_id AS projectId, environment_id AS environmentId, site_id AS siteId, method AS method, url AS url, response_code AS responseCode, response_time AS responseTime, logged_time AS loggedTime, header AS header, parameter AS parameter, form_parameter AS formParameter, response_body AS responseBody, response_header AS responseHeader FROM history WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, project_id AS projectId, environment_id AS environmentId, site_id AS siteId, method AS method, url AS url, response_code AS responseCode, response_time AS responseTime, logged_time AS loggedTime, header AS header, parameter AS parameter, form_parameter AS formParameter, response_body AS responseBody, response_header AS responseHeader FROM history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND response_code >= 400 AND response_code < 600 AND logged_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT id AS id, user_id AS userId, project_id AS projectId, environment_id AS environmentId, site_id AS siteId, method AS method, url AS url, response_code AS responseCode, response_time AS responseTime, logged_time AS loggedTime, header AS header, parameter AS parameter, form_parameter AS formParameter, response_body AS responseBody, response_header AS responseHeader FROM history WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
